Bash(curl -s --max-time 120 -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer sbp_2d452169940aac81296146923699e90f6bed365f" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\\"query\\": \\"DO \\$\\$\\nDECLARE\\n  p RECORD;\\n  new_qual TEXT;\\n  new_check TEXT;\\n  policy_sql TEXT;\\n  role_str TEXT;\\n  fixed INT := 0;\\nBEGIN\\n  FOR p IN\\n    SELECT schemaname, tablename, policyname, permissive, roles, cmd, qual, with_check\\n    FROM pg_policies\\n    WHERE schemaname = 'public'\\n      AND \(qual LIKE '%auth.uid\(\)%' OR with_check LIKE '%auth.uid\(\)%'\)\\n  LOOP\\n    new_qual  := REPLACE\(p.qual,        'auth.uid\(\)', '\(SELECT auth.uid\(\)\)'\);\\n    new_check := REPLACE\(p.with_check,  'auth.uid\(\)', '\(SELECT auth.uid\(\)\)'\);\\n\\n    EXECUTE format\('DROP POLICY IF EXISTS %I ON %I.%I',\\n      p.policyname, p.schemaname, p.tablename\);\\n\\n    policy_sql := format\('CREATE POLICY %I ON %I.%I AS %s FOR %s',\\n      p.policyname, p.schemaname, p.tablename,\\n      p.permissive,\\n      p.cmd\);\\n\\n    IF p.roles IS DISTINCT FROM ARRAY['public']::name[] THEN\\n      SELECT string_agg\(quote_ident\(r\), ', '\) INTO role_str\\n      FROM unnest\(p.roles\) r;\\n      policy_sql := policy_sql || ' TO ' || role_str;\\n    END IF;\\n\\n    IF new_qual IS NOT NULL THEN\\n      policy_sql := policy_sql || ' USING ' || new_qual;\\n    END IF;\\n    IF new_check IS NOT NULL THEN\\n      policy_sql := policy_sql || ' WITH CHECK ' || new_check;\\n    END IF;\\n\\n    EXECUTE policy_sql;\\n    fixed := fixed + 1;\\n  END LOOP;\\n  RAISE NOTICE 'Fixed % RLS policies', fixed;\\nEND;\\n\\$\\$;\\"}" "https://api.supabase.com/v1/projects/hjvnkintvjogwljchwcq/database/query")

ins_conds TEXT[];\\n  upd_using_arr TEXT[]; upd_chk_arr TEXT[];\\n  del_conds TEXT[];\\n  m_sel TEXT; m_ins TEXT;\\n  m_upd_using TEXT; m_upd_chk TEXT;\\n  m_del TEXT;\\n  fixed INT := 0;\\nBEGIN\\n  FOR tbl IN\\n    SELECT tablename\\n    FROM \(\\n      SELECT tablename,\\n        count\(*\) FILTER \(WHERE cmd IN \('SELECT','ALL'\)\) sel_n,\\n        count\(*\) FILTER \(WHERE cmd IN \('INSERT','ALL'\)\) ins_n,\\n        count\(*\) FILTER \(WHERE cmd IN \('UPDATE','ALL'\)\) upd_n,\\n        count\(*\) FILTER \(WHERE cmd IN \('DELETE','ALL'\)\) del_n\\n      FROM pg_policies\\n      WHERE schemaname='public' AND permissive='PERMISSIVE' AND roles='{public}'::name[]\\n      GROUP BY tablename\\n    \) t\\n    WHERE sel_n > 1 OR ins_n > 1 OR upd_n > 1 OR del_n > 1\\n    ORDER BY tablename\\n  LOOP\\n    sel_conds:='{}'; ins_conds:='{}'; upd_using_arr:='{}'; upd_chk_arr:='{}'; del_conds:='{}';\\n    m_sel:=NULL; m_ins:=NULL; m_upd_using:=NULL; m_upd_chk:=NULL; m_del:=NULL;\\n\\n    FOR pol IN\\n      SELECT policyname, cmd, qual, with_check\\n      FROM pg_policies\\n      WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename=tbl\\n        AND permissive='PERMISSIVE' AND roles='{public}'::name[]\\n    LOOP\\n      IF pol.cmd IN \('SELECT','ALL'\) AND pol.qual IS NOT NULL THEN\\n        sel_conds := array_append\(sel_conds, pol.qual\);\\n      END IF;\\n      IF pol.cmd IN \('INSERT','ALL'\) THEN\\n        ins_conds := array_append\(ins_conds, COALESCE\(pol.with_check, pol.qual, 'true'\)\);\\n      END IF;\\n      IF pol.cmd IN \('UPDATE','ALL'\) THEN\\n        IF pol.qual IS NOT NULL THEN upd_using_arr := array_append\(upd_using_arr, pol.qual\); END IF;\\n        upd_chk_arr := array_append\(upd_chk_arr, COALESCE\(pol.with_check, pol.qual, 'true'\)\);\\n      END IF;\\n      IF pol.cmd IN \('DELETE','ALL'\) AND pol.qual IS NOT NULL THEN\\n        del_conds := array_append\(del_conds, pol.qual\);\\n      END IF;\\n      EXECUTE format\('DROP POLICY IF EXISTS %I ON public.%I', pol.policyname, tbl\);\\n    END LOOP;\\n\\n    -- Merge SELECT\\n    IF 'true' = ANY\(sel_conds\) THEN m_sel:='true';\\n    ELSE SELECT string_agg\(u, ' OR ' ORDER BY u\) INTO m_sel FROM \(SELECT DISTINCT u FROM unnest\(sel_conds\) u WHERE u IS NOT NULL\) s; END IF;\\n\\n    -- Merge INSERT\\n    IF 'true' = ANY\(ins_conds\) THEN m_ins:='true';\\n    ELSE SELECT string_agg\(u, ' OR ' ORDER BY u\) INTO m_ins FROM \(SELECT DISTINCT u FROM unnest\(ins_conds\) u WHERE u IS NOT NULL\) s; END IF;\\n\\n    -- Merge UPDATE USING\\n    IF 'true' = ANY\(upd_using_arr\) THEN m_upd_using:='true';\\n    ELSE SELECT string_agg\(u, ' OR ' ORDER BY u\) INTO m_upd_using FROM \(SELECT DISTINCT u FROM unnest\(upd_using_arr\) u WHERE u IS NOT NULL\) s; END IF;\\n\\n    -- Merge UPDATE WITH CHECK\\n    IF 'true' = ANY\(upd_chk_arr\) THEN m_upd_chk:='true';\\n    ELSE SELECT string_agg\(u, ' OR ' ORDER BY u\) INTO m_upd_chk FROM \(SELECT DISTINCT u FROM unnest\(upd_chk_arr\) u WHERE u IS NOT NULL\) s; END IF;\\n\\n    -- Merge DELETE\\n    IF 'true' = ANY\(del_conds\) THEN m_del:='true';\\n    ELSE SELECT string_agg\(u, ' OR ' ORDER BY u\) INTO m_del FROM \(SELECT DISTINCT u FROM unnest\(del_conds\) u WHERE u IS NOT NULL\) s; END IF;\\n\\n    -- Create merged policies\\n    IF m_sel IS NOT NULL THEN\\n      EXECUTE format\('CREATE POLICY \\\\\\"rls_select\\\\\\" ON public.%I AS PERMISSIVE FOR SELECT USING \(%s\)', tbl, m_sel\);\\n    END IF;\\n    IF m_ins IS NOT NULL THEN\\n      EXECUTE format\('CREATE POLICY \\\\\\"rls_insert\\\\\\" ON public.%I AS PERMISSIVE FOR INSERT WITH CHECK \(%s\)', tbl, m_ins\);\\n    END IF;\\n    IF m_upd_using IS NOT NULL THEN\\n      IF m_upd_chk IS NOT NULL AND m_upd_chk <> m_upd_using THEN\\n        EXECUTE format\('CREATE POLICY \\\\\\"rls_update\\\\\\" ON public.%I AS PERMISSIVE FOR UPDATE USING \(%s\) WITH CHECK \(%s\)', tbl, m_upd_using, m_upd_chk\);\\n      ELSE\\n        EXECUTE format\('CREATE POLICY \\\\\\"rls_update\\\\\\" ON public.%I AS PERMISSIVE FOR UPDATE USING \(%s\)', tbl, m_upd_using\);\\n      END IF;\\n    END IF;\\n    IF m_del IS NOT NULL THEN\\n      EXECUTE format\('CREATE POLICY \\\\\\"rls_delete\\\\\\" ON public.%I AS PERMISSIVE FOR DELETE USING \(%s\)', tbl, m_del\);\\n    END IF;\\n\\n    fixed := fixed + 1;\\n  END LOOP;\\n  RAISE NOTICE 'Merged policies for % tables', fixed;\\nEND;\\n\\$\\$;\\"}" "https://api.supabase.com/v1/projects/hjvnkintvjogwljchwcq/database/query")
